Each {killCooldown.0.stacksPerStep} kill stacks cut the adjacent ability's cooldown by {killCooldown.0.step.0.percent}%, then {killCooldown.0.step.1.percent}%, {killCooldown.0.step.2.percent}%, {killCooldown.0.step.3.percent}%, and {killCooldown.0.tailPercent}% per step after that. Reductions add up; the cooldown never falls below {killCooldown.0.minimumSeconds} sec.
{killDamage.0.percent}% of the kill bonus also applies to every Offense ability on the ship, not only the adjacent one.
{ownerBurstModifier.0.pullLeadSeconds} sec before the burst, enemies in its radius are pulled toward you with {ownerBurstModifier.0.pullImpulse} impulse. Bosses are not pulled.
Kills charge the star from {ownerBurstModifier.0.chargeRadius} units around you.
The burst also hits enemies within {thermalBurst.0.areaRadius} units of the target for {thermalBurst.0.areaDamagePercent}% of its damage. They get no Thermal stacks.

The burst leaves a field for {thermalBurst.0.smolderSeconds} sec within {thermalBurst.0.smolderRadius} units that adds {thermalBurst.0.smolderStacksPerSecond} Thermal stack per second to enemies inside it.
After a spend, the target's Armor is reduced by {kinetic.0.rendPercent}% for {kinetic.0.rendSeconds} sec.
When you slow down, the sonic state lasts {sonic.0.lingerSeconds} sec longer.
Fragmentable: at the largest size the module splits into single-cell fragments that can be placed anywhere. The worst-placed fragment sets the zone level bonus. Neighbours count from every fragment.
Turret auto-aim prefers the valid target with the lowest health percentage.
While sonic, turn capability increases by {sonic.0.turnBonusPercent}%.

At {electricSpread.0.threshold} Electric stacks, spread {electricSpread.0.stacks} stacks to {electricSpread.0.targetCount} nearest enemies within {electricSpread.0.radius}; {electricSpread.0.cooldownSeconds}s cooldown per target.
Applied damage status durations +{statusDuration.0.increasePercent}%; includes Frozen, excludes freeze cooldown.

Gain Attack Speed percentage points equal to {owner.0.amountPercent}% of total Armor.
The lower offensive power also gains {owner.0.amountPercent}% of the main conversion bonus; no feedback stacking.

Fire a second lance after {speedLance.0.echoDelaySeconds}s in the same direction, with {speedLance.0.echoPercent}% of the first damage. Uses the original speed sample.
The first target hit receives {speedLance.0.firstTargetElectricStacks} Electric stacks; other pierced targets receive none.
Max Health +{owner.0.amountPercent}% of this module's Gold Armor; recalculated when Gold is spent.
While health is at or below {threshold.0.healthPercent}%, ability damage is {threshold.0.damagePercent}% higher.
Energy Power gains {owner.0.amountPercent}% of the current reserve, so the bonus shrinks as the reserve is spent.
While the normal shield is full, the reserve keeps filling while you take damage, at {battery.0.damagedFillPercent}% of the normal regeneration rate. The normal shield's recharge delay still applies.
While health is at or below {threshold.0.healthPercent}%, movement speed is {threshold.0.movementPercent}% higher.

Each Q, E, F and R use charges a storm. At {storm.0.chargesRequired} charges, your next Primary hit discharges it onto {storm.0.targetCount} random enemies within {storm.0.radius} units, each taking {storm.0.primaryDamagePercent}% of the triggering Primary hit as damage and {storm.0.electricStacks} Electric stacks.
A direct ability hit deals +{alternating.0.bonusPercent}% damage when its damage type differs from your previous direct ability hit on the same enemy. Damage over time does not change the sequence.
Each Offense use grants {clot.0.armorPerCost} Armor for every point of health it spent, lasting {clot.0.seconds} seconds. A new grant replaces the previous one.
The heal window after an Offense hit becomes {debt.0.healWindowSeconds} seconds.
When this module levels a Utility ability, every other installed Utility ability gains 2 uses toward its next level.
